historical_grid_benchmark.status: research_only; retrospective lag-feature benchmark, not IMD forecast calibration

promotion_requirements: Independent observations at the claimed output scale
Original issued forecast and observation pairs with exact accumulation intervals
Measured predictor availability before issue time
Temporal and spatial holdouts locked before candidate selection
Compare against unchanged-parent, persistence and climatology baselines
Check skill by lead time and rainfall intensity, including heavy rain
No agreement clipping or arbitrary 6-10 mm cap
Reconciliation weights estimated on development data, never test data
Explicit model review before any default serving change
